svg.title: OntoSPK complete domain association matrix
svg.desc: Derived reading projection of frozen OntoSPK core v2.0.0; exact source and omitted relations are recorded in diagram-provenance.json. Domain boxes are not OntoUML classes.

g.text: All 286 native associations. Rows: first endpoint; columns: second endpoint.
D01-D12 are local domains; B is the separately governed external boundary bucket.
Counts are association declarations, not records, dependencies, temporal order or causal strength.
Diagonal cells retain within-domain associations. All 34 generalizations are outside this matrix.
Source: native 0.41.0 / core v2.0.0. Full ID-level aggregation and omissions: diagram-provenance.json.
